nodes.label: IpAllowlist
nodes.rationale: Restricts a route subtree to clients inside configured IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs - defence in depth on top of BearerTokenAuth, so even a leaked token is useless off an allowlisted network. IPv4-mapped IPv6 peers are normalised so a plain IPv4 CIDR still matches, invalid CIDR syntax throws at construction, and a non-matching or missing client IP fails closed with 403.

nodes.label: Distrusting x-forwarded-for
nodes.rationale: getClientIp reads request.remoteAddress (the socket peer) by default and deliberately does not trust x-forwarded-for, because that header is client-spoofable when no proxy sits in front - clients that can reach the app directly would walk straight through the allowlist. Override only behind a trusted proxy that strips the inbound header and sets its own.
